notes.title: DLC2「山巓の魔人」追加
notes.notes:
DLC第二弾となる「山巓の魔人」を追加しました。
今回は短編となり、10分ほどで読み終わるボリュームとなっております。
別作品である「DROOM」の前日譚のような話になるので、興味のある方はそちらもチェックして頂けたら幸いです。

notes.title: 不具合修正
notes.notes: 細かいバグを修正致しました。

notes.title: Free DLC No. 1 "Activity Record of the Abandoned Village Walking Group - Mystery
notes.notes:
Pleased to announce the release of the first free DLC, "Activity Record of the Abandoned Village Walking Group - Mystery of a Giant Abandoned Village Appeared in a Big City".
Fixed a route-related bug.

notes.title: 無料DLC第一弾序章「廃村散策会活動記録～大都市に突如として現れた巨大廃村の謎」配信
notes.notes: We have begun production of the first free DLC, "Activity Record of the Abandoned Village Walking Group - The Mystery of a Giant Abandoned Village that Suddenly Appeared in a Major City". And we are pleased to distribute part 1 of it. We will be updating it from time to time, so please stay tuned. The English version is still under construction and will be distributed as soon as it is completed.

notes.title: 不具合修正
notes.notes: 選択肢中に放火ボタンを押すとフリーズする不具合の修正、CGの一つを押すとフリーズする不具合を修正しました。

notes.title: Fixed a bug that caused the arson button to stop working once it was pressed.
notes.notes: We have fixed the bug that the arson button does not work once you press it. We apologize for the inconvenience, but if you are in the middle of the game and have confirmed that bug, please start from START and the bug will be fixed.
